title: Survey model
description: A noise-made island as a stacked survey model, its contour rings rising off a slate plinth. A kernel traces every ring, and all of them draw as lit enamel tubes in one draw, with every fifth ring bold and the soundings below the shoreline dashed. A graticule, a north arrow and a scale bar sit on the plinth. Point at a ring to pick it out.
line: An island as a stack of contour rings, traced on the GPU.
hint: point at a ring · drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
